projectTitle: Courier iOS SDK (courier.com): Notification Inbox, Push and Preferences
description: Official Swift SDK for Courier (courier.com), the notification platform. Add a prebuilt in-app notification Inbox (CourierInboxView for SwiftUI, CourierInbox for UIKit), APNs push notifications with token sync and delivery tracking, and a notification preference center to iOS 15+ apps.
rules: Install with Swift Package Manager from https://github.com/trycourier/courier-ios. CocoaPods stopped at 6.0.10.
Sign in with await Courier.shared.signIn(userId:accessToken:), passing the JWT from your backend as accessToken.
Use CourierInboxView (SwiftUI) or CourierInbox (UIKit) for the prebuilt Inbox, and Courier.shared.addInboxListener for a custom UI. Remove listeners on teardown.
For push, subclass CourierDelegate in your AppDelegate, and add a Notification Service Extension to track delivery while the app is closed.
Mint the Courier JWT on your backend with your Courier API key (POST /auth/issue-token). Never put the API key in the app.
Call signIn once, after your own login resolves. Credentials persist across app launches. Call signOut when the user logs out.
The user_id in the JWT scope must match the userId passed to signIn, or the Inbox loads empty.
Scopes: inbox:read:messages inbox:write:events for Inbox; add read:preferences write:preferences for preferences and write:user-tokens for push.
Always set expires_in when minting. The SDK does not refresh tokens: mint a new JWT and call signIn again before it expires.
EU workspaces: mint the JWT at https://api.eu.courier.com/auth/issue-token and pass EU apiUrls to signIn. Token and client must be in the same region.
